info.bio:
Banda formada en 1986 por los hermanos Chris y Rich Robinson, bajo el nombre de Mr. Crowe’s Garden. En 1990 editan su debut Shake Your Money Maker con un éxito considerable, sobre todo a partir de la edición del single Hard To Handle, original del cantante de soul Otis Redding.

Conocidos por su visión personal de la escena musical y los polémicos comentarios del cantante, su segundo disco, The Southern Harmony And Musical Companion, editado en 1992

scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: La revolución iniciada en Chicago por Souled American y Uncle Tupelo (No Depression: baladas country con la furia del hardcore) se convierte en los noventa en un género propio: sus herederos abandonan el hardcore por los sonidos más espartanos y tradicionales. Son Volt de Jay Farrar y Wilco de Jeff Tweedy (Being There, Yankee Hotel Foxtrot); Will Oldham (Palace) arranca el movimiento; Freakwater, Ida, Handsome Family, Retsin, Blue Mountain, Whiskeytown, Grant Lee Buffalo, Citizens' Utilities, Willard Grant Conspiracy. El «chamber folk» de Lambchop, Lullaby For The Working Class, Geraldine Fibbers y Pinetop Seven; el country-rock de Volebeats, Ass Ponys, Sixteen Horsepower, Old 97's y los terroristas Grifters; el folk-rock de Swell, Counting Crows, Cracker, Cake, Hootie & The Blowfish; los Black Crowes; Belle And Sebastian, Arab Strap y los polacos Atman.

xref.title: Formation and Early Cover Gigs (1996)
xref.body: The band started in 1996 in Colin McDonald's grandmother's basement, playing cover songs, including tracks by Tom Petty, The Beatles, The Tragically Hip, James Brown, and The Black Crowes. They gigged frequently in Antigonish high schools and local bars like Chuggles, Piper's Pub, and Pats Place, sometimes needing permission slips to play underage. "We started in 1996 and my grandmother's basement playing cover songs."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Production/Engineering Credits
xref.body: Sylvia Massy worked behind the board for a wide array of prominent artists, including Aerosmith, Prince, Bobby Brown, the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Slayer, Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers, Katting Kage, Johnny Cash, a Taylor Hawkins and Civil Project, System of a Down, The Smashing Pumpkins, The Black Crowes, and The Beastie Boys. This extensive list showcases her versatility and expertise across genres. "Since then, she's worked behind the board for Erasmith, Prince, Bobby Brown, the Red Hot Chili Peppers Slayer, Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers Catering Cache, Johnny Cash, a Taylor Hawkins and Civil Project, System of a Down, The Smashing Pumpkins, The Black Cros and The Beastie Boys."
